Next year's iPhone Pro models are expected to feature an all-new all-glass design to celebrate the iPhone's 20th anniversary. And today, a new leak has detailed Apple's progress on these innovative models.

Here is the latest news about Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

Apple's first foldable model — the innovative iPhone Ultra — is just weeks away from its debut. But next year will bring another uniquely designed new iPhone.

There are rumours that Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. According to reports, these new models will feature larger screens with a quad-curved display extending to the edges of the body, creating a visually borderless effect.

Weibo tipster "Fixed Focus Digital" posted new information today, updating on Apple's progress in achieving this distinctive look.

He said Apple is using the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but is making modifications with a more rounded material.

The post also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Device slimness

It is still too early to determine the body thickness and design materials Apple is pursuing. However, current signs indicate this new model will draw inspiration from both the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritise slimness in the same way.

Based on these latest updates, it seems we can expect to see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra on this model, while still delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users do not want slimness to be a priority. But if Apple can deliver a comparable experience on a slightly slimmer device, paired with a unique all-glass look, it would be very appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments section.
